selector-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed selector. `mat-icon` is Angular Material — use `ix-icon`/`tn-icon`. `.tn-list-item__*` is internal @truenas/ui-components markup — use (or add) a mixin in src/assets/styles/mixins/tn-list.scss instead, see "Known Library Gaps" in TRUENAS_UI_INTEGRATION.md. Angular Material dialogs are gone (NAS-141066), so `mat-dialog-*`/`mdc-dialog-*` selectors can never match — style the `tn-dialog` overlay via its `panelClass` and `.tn-dialog-panel` instead.
